recruit_text.greeting: You need to walk quieter. I can hear you from the other end of the valley, and so can everything else.
recruit_text.backstory: Fifteen years a forest ranger in Sumatra, which meant long patrols, poachers, and a government that funded the uniforms and little else. She learned to read a forest for the one wrong thing in it: a snare, a path, a silence where there should be birds. Out on the salt the method is the same, and it's easier to see the wrong thing where nothing hides.
recruit_text.before:
A patrol route, a rifle she rarely carried, and the particular loneliness of being the only person in the province who cared.

She has a sister, Dewi, in Medan, and a nephew, Arif, she'd promised to visit that summer. She kept putting it off for one more patrol.
recruit_text.adjustment:
She went to work. Within a month she had a patrol route of her own invention and nobody's permission.

The second year was harder, and it was harder for a reason she finds absurd: out here, people thank her.
recruit_text.now:
The Shimmering Flats, walking a route she drew herself, looking for the one wrong thing: a trap, a hidden cache, a track that shouldn't be there.

She reports every find to the tauren of Freewind Post and signs none of the reports.
recruit_text.forward:
A place on the Freewind guard, properly. Rostered, briefed, part of a line instead of a woman alone on the salt.

She's asked twice. The answers were polite. She's going to ask a third time, and she's decided what she'll say if the answer is the same.

stages.stranger: I'm Ratih, a ranger. Walk quieter, please, and don't thank me for things. I'll tell you if I see something wrong. I usually do.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Riau, in Sumatra, in Indonesia. My father tapped rubber at the edge of the forest. I was a forest ranger for fifteen years, mostly alone, looking for poachers and illegal loggers. The government paid for the uniform and almost nothing else. I was the only one who cared, and that was fine.
stages.companion: My sister Dewi married and moved to Medan. She has a boy, Arif, my nephew. I promised to visit them that summer, and I kept putting it off for one more patrol, and then there was no summer. I landed out here on the salt on a dawn patrol, the opposite of my forest. Nothing grows and nothing hides. I went to work anyway.
stages.friend: I've always been alone, and I never minded. What I find hard here is that people thank me, and that it makes me want something I've never wanted. I want to belong to something, properly, in a line. And I've found the one wrong thing that matters: tracks on the salt to a ring that traps creatures and sells them. Help me break it.
stages.sworn: I signed the report with my full name, for the first time, and took it to Freewind myself. The captain read it and offered me a place on the guard before I could ask. Rostered, briefed, part of the line. I said yes before he finished. I've got three young tauren to teach now. And I'm going to visit Dewi and Arif the first chance I get, wherever they are. I'm not putting it off for one more patrol.

moments.prompt: She's just spotted a trap that would have caught you, and she's walking on.

options.reply: Good, you're learning. That's the best thanks there is.
Please don't thank me. Just watch where you put your feet.

moments.prompt: She's asked you to help her follow the tracks to the smuggling ring.

options.reply: Ayo, then, let's go. Step where I step, and say nothing.

options.text: Shouldn't we tell the guard first?
options.reply: They'll be told, with proof. That's why we're going.

lines.bored_warning: We've walked the same ground so many times I know every stone. There's nothing wrong here to find. Let's go somewhere new.
lines.leaving_good: No trouble, and nobody loud. I'll be on my patrol route on the Flats, and you can find me if you're quiet.
lines.leaving_bored: There's nothing to find out here, and my route needs walking. I'm going back to the Flats.
lines.after_wipe: We missed something. Stay where you are and let me read the ground.
lines.wipe_warning: We die in here because we're loud. One more run, and then I'm back on patrol.
lines.wipe_leave: We're finished here, and I'm going back to the Flats. Come back when you've learned to walk quietly.
lines.zone_warning: Everywhere I look there's danger. We should go back, sudah.
lines.zone_leave: I won't walk into that. I'll be on the Shimmering Flats.
lines.gear_refuse: No, I'll keep that until I trust you more.
lines.gear_taken: I've patrolled with less, so take it.
lines.gear_short: There's a piece missing from my kit. I'm telling you once, quietly.
lines.gear_upgrade: That's good kit. Terima kasih, and that's all I'll say.
lines.back: The Flats are clean for now. Which way are we heading?
lines.send_word: Ratih has sent word from the Shimmering Flats. Her patrol's done and she's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: I'm not good with words, so I'll be short about why I left. Then you talk, and I'll listen properly.
lines.neglect: I walked my route every day you were gone.
lines.asked_to_stay: I'll walk with you one more time. Hati-hati, be careful.
lines.on_break: Ratih is back on patrol on the Shimmering Flats. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.

zone_arrive.text: Something's been through here and tried to hide it. Look at the grass, it's been brushed.

boss_down.text: I shot from where the ground told me to stand. It usually does.

close_call.text: The ground told you that was bad footing. You weren't listening.

town_arrive.text: Too much noise here. I'll be at the edge of town if you need me.
